Positiv geht nach oben. Zum Aufsetzen gi: Positive goes up. To set a part down, use *Place on the bed*.
Positiv verschiebt den ganzen Dichtweg n: Positive values move the entire seal path outward; negative values move it inward.
Preis dieser ganzen Spule in der daneben: The price of this entire spool in the currency entered alongside.
Profilkennungen werden kleingeschrieben: Profile identifiers are lowercase — the title beside them is not.
Projekt mit Geometrie, Verlauf und Param: Write the project — geometry, history and parameters — into one file.
Projiziert das Bild flach von oben — für: Projects the image flat from above — for lids and flat plates.
Protokoll anhängen — es kann Dateipfade: Attach the log — it can contain file paths from your computer
Prägt ein Muster als echte Geometrie auf: Presses a pattern into a face as real geometry — knurling for grip, honeycomb or rib for looks. What the slicer gets is what you see.
Prüfbericht und Chat ein- oder ausblende: Show or hide the report and the chat.
Prüfbericht: was nicht stimmt, meist mit: Report: what is wrong, usually with a button that fixes it.
Prüfen Sie Passungen mit dem verwendeten: Check fits with the material you use. Repeat test prints when the printer, material or print settings change.
Prüfen Sie Spiel und Übermaß der gewählt: Check the clearance and interference of the selected material profiles.
Prüfen Sie den aktuellen Bestand. Eine R: Check the current stock. Reversing the record must explicitly preserve this newer count.
Check the printer and filament at the top.
Prüfen Sie vor dem Übernehmen die Folgen: Check the effects on filaments and references before applying.
Prüfstück drucken, Passung ausprobieren: Print the test piece, try the fit and enter the measured value in the material profile.
Prüft Innen- und Außengewinde auf gleich: Checks that the internal and external threads have the same pitch and the intended diametral clearance.
Prüft das Spiel zwischen Öffnung und Geg: Checks the clearance between the opening and its counterpart based on their materials.
Prüft das Übermaß der Verbindung anhand: Checks the interference of the connection based on its materials.
Prüft die Maße und folgt den Teilmateria: Checks the dimensions using each part's material. The parts are not moved.
Prüft geometrisch begründete Lagen und v: Checks orientations derived from the geometry and compares the best ones using layer analysis. Off uses a fast face-based heuristic.
Prüft, ob beide Flächen parallel und in: Checks whether both faces are parallel and lie in the same plane.
Prüft, ob zwei Teile in ihre Lage gelang: Checks whether two parts can reach their position — not just whether they fit once there. The first selected part is pushed into the second, turned, or first pushed and then turned.
Prüfung abgebrochen. Prüfen Sie die Druc: Check cancelled. Check the print recommendations again.
Prüfung — das Ergebnis steht im Prüfberi: Check — the result is in the report, not in the view
Punkt ausgewählt — ziehen oder Koordinat: Point selected — drag it or enter coordinates.
Punkt oder Element anklicken; mit Strg m: Click a point or element; hold Ctrl to select several.
Punkt: jeder Klick setzt einen, ein Klic: Point: every click sets one, a click on an existing one grabs it.
Punkte einfügen und entfernen lässt sich: Points can be inserted and removed on a curve through points.
Punktwahl beendet. Die eingetragenen Pun: Point picking ended. The points entered stay.
Quellen in Bausteindateien müssen einen: Sources in part files must use a relative path.
Quer zur Lasche gemessen. Null heißt: so: Measured across the tab. Zero means: as wide as the washer of the screw.
Querschnitt durch ein Bauteil: ein Zapfe: Section through a part: a peg sits in a hole, the gap between them is dimensioned. The number comes from the material profile and is not typed into the dialog.
Radius am Ende der Kante. Dazwischen änd: Radius at the end of the edge. In between, the fillet changes evenly — with intermediate points, as a smooth curve through every value.
Radius der Rundung. Null misst ihn an de: Radius of the rounded surface. Zero measures it at the clicked spot; negative means hollow, with the lettering inside a ring.
Radius der Verrundung, bei einem Verlauf: Radius of the fillet; with a variable radius, the radius at the start of the edge. Larger than the thinnest adjoining material will not work — the rounding then has no room left.
Radius der senkrechten Außenecken. Die I: Radius of the vertical outer corners. Inner radii are set on the compartments.
Radius of the vertical outer corners.
Radius des Pfades, dem der Querschnitt f: Radius of the path the cross-section follows. It must be larger than half the cross-section, or the inside kinks.
Rand oder Wände dieser Tasche sind durch: The rim or the walls of this pocket have openings, or one side is open — it cannot be stretched as a whole. Change a wall with “Offset face”.
Rasterabstand und Ursprung müssen endlic: Grid spacing and origin must be finite numbers.
Rechnet auf einem Raster; Maße und Kante: Computes on a grid; dimensions and edges get rounded.
Rechnet die Außenwand auf ihr Sollmaß st: Computes the outer wall to its nominal size instead of to the centre of the line. Right for fits, unnecessary otherwise.
Rechnet die Textur eines Objekts auf die: Reduces the texture of an object to the number of filaments loaded and stores the result as filament assignments.
Rechnet eigene Bausteine so, wie das Pro: Computes your own parts as the project was saved; your newer version stays in the parts folder.
Rechteck, Langloch, Kreis oder Vieleck —: Rectangle, slot, circle or polygon — the dimensions sit below.
Rechteck, Langloch, Kreis, Vieleck — ode: Rectangle, slot, circle, polygon — or a hole pattern: bolt circle and hole grid give as many holes as set below.
Rechteck: Gegenecke klicken oder Breite: Rectangle: click the opposite corner or type width and height.
Rechteck: erster Klick setzt eine Ecke,: Rectangle: the first click sets one corner, the second the opposite corner.
Rechteckige Dichtung oder runde Schnur e: Rectangular gasket or round cord along the same closed path.
Rechteckiger Umriss aus Länge und Breite: Rectangular outline from length and width.
Rechts im *Prüfbericht* steht, dass das: The *Report* on the right says that the part sticks out of the build volume. Click that finding.
Rechts im *Prüfbericht* steht, was Solid: The *Report* on the right lists what Solidon found in the model.
Rechts im Prüfbericht stehen zwei Hinwei: The report on the right holds two notes: nothing to repair, and the hole was enlarged for printing.
Rechts im Prüfbericht steht, was die Rep: The report on the right shows what the repair found and closed.
Rechts unter *Auswahl*: Klappen Sie *Fil: On the right under *Selection*: expand *Filament and printing*.
Rechts unter *Auswahl*: Klicken Sie auf: On the right under *Selection*: click *Hollow out*.
On the right under *Selection*: click *Drill a bore*.
On the right under *Selection*: click *Orient for printing*.
On the right under *Selection*: click *Put text on*.
Rechtsklick oder {key} entfernt die gewä: Right-click or {key} removes the selected constraint.
Regelmäßiges Vieleck mit wählbarer Ecken: Regular polygon with a chosen number of corners.
Regler schiebt die Teile auseinander. Nu: The slider pushes the parts apart. View only — what gets exported stays where it is.
Reicht von der Oberkante bis zur gegenüb: Reaches from the top edge to the opposite side of the body — the lower outline then lies exactly there, and the depth does not count.
Reparieren Sie das Modell und starten Si: Repair the model, then start rebuilding again.
Richtet GLB und GLTF von Y-oben auf Soli: Reorients GLB and GLTF from Y-up to Solidon's Z-up.
Richtet aus, wo außen ist. Ohne das ersc: Settles which side is outside. Without it faces appear dark or missing.
Settles which side is outside. Without it faces appear dark or vanish.
Richtung der Fläche. Aus einer angeklick: Direction of the face. A clicked face fills it in.
Richtung der linearen Reihe. Ohne Richtu: Direction of the linear row. Without one every copy would sit on top of the last.
Richtung der lokalen Z-Achse. 0/0/0 behä: Direction of the local Z axis. 0/0/0 keeps the existing upward orientation.
Richtung nach außen an der gewählten Obe: Outward direction at the selected surface. Three zeros use the axis.
Richtung, in der die Ebene steht. Die ge: Direction the plane faces. The drawn line fills it in; set by hand, the three numbers form an arrow perpendicular to the cut face.
Richtung, in die der Baustein zeigt — so: The direction the part points in — as long as no feature is chosen. A clicked face sets it itself.
Richtung, in die die Schrift zeigt. Aus: The direction the text faces. A clicked face supplies it; by hand, 0/0/1 is up.
Richtung, in die gebohrt wird. Z ist sen: The direction to drill in. Z goes straight down from above, X and Y through a side wall.
Ring um einen runden Gegenstand — Flasch: Ring around a round object — bottle, can, hair dryer. With a base it becomes a cup. Mounted with keyholes, screw holes, pegboard hooks or a clamp.
Rippe mit schrägem Auslauf: Sie verstärk: A rib with a sloped run-out: it stiffens a wall without making it thicker. It stays thinner than the wall it sits on, otherwise it shows on the other side.
Rohrbogen in einem Schritt: a pipe bend in one step
Ruht, weil er einen ausgeschalteten Schr: Inactive because it needs a switched-off step.
Runde Löcher, Langlöcher oder sechseckig: Round holes, slots, or hexagonal openings.
Runde Stifte drucken am saubersten. Sech: Round pins print cleanest. Hexagon and dovetail secure against twisting, the dovetail also against being pulled apart.
Runder Querschnitt mit gleichmäßigem Rad: Round cross-section with a constant radius.
Runder oder rechteckiger Behälter; alle: Round or rectangular container; all outside dimensions remain editable.
Rundet die gewählten Kanten ab, mit eine: Rounds the selected edges, with one radius or with a radius that changes from start to end. This works on an exact body as on a mesh.
Rundet die senkrechten Außenecken. Der I: Rounds the vertical outer corners. The inner radius preserves the wall thickness.
Rät bei einer unklaren Anfrage, statt na: Guesses on an unclear request instead of asking. Not suitable for Solidon.
Rückgängig machen, einen Schritt im Verl: Undo, or change, switch off or delete a step in the history.
Rückplatte mit Schraubenlöchern und nach: A back plate with screw holes and a shelf standing forward. The holes are through holes from the standard parts table.
Rückt die Kamera auf den gewählten Körpe: Moves the camera onto the selected body — with nothing selected, onto the whole scene.
Rückt hohe, schmale Teile auf ihrer Plat: Moves tall, narrow parts closer to the centre of their plate when space is available. Other parts and spacing are preserved.
STEP speichert bearbeitbare Flächen und: STEP stores editable faces and edges, but this body is made of fixed triangles. STL and 3MF take it as it is.
STEP speichert echte Flächen und Kanten,: STEP stores true faces and edges; this model consists of fixed triangles. “Convert to faces and edges” turns them into faces and edges; STL and 3MF take it as it is.
STL kennt keine Einheit. Automatisch hei: STL carries no unit. Automatic means: guess, and ask when in doubt.
Sage das in deiner Antwort, bevor der Nu: Say this in your answer before the user decides.
Schaltet auch diesen Schritt aus; er rec: Also switches this step off; it only computes again once you switch it on.
Schaltet den Schritt aus; was auf ihm au: Switches the step off; whatever builds on it rests too.
Schaltet den Schritt wieder ein; die Sch: Switches the step back on; the steps after it compute again.
Schaltet zum nächsten Schritt — auch, we: Moves on to the next step — even if the current one was not done.
Schichten über drei Viertel der Düse haf: Layers above three quarters of the nozzle bond poorly.
Schichten, Temperaturen, Farbe und Stütz: Set layers, temperatures, colour and supports — and have it sliced.
Schiebt das Modell in die Mitte der Druc: Moves the model to the middle of the print bed. A model from a CAD program often has its origin in a corner and would otherwise sit far off to one side.
Schiebt entgegen der Achsrichtung, also: Pushes against the axis direction, that is from the other side.
Schlage Normteilmaße nach: Kernloch, Dur: Look up standard part dimensions: tap drill hole, clearance hole, width across flats and more — instead of guessing them.
Schlanke Teile zur Mitte: Move slender parts towards the centre
Schließen. In dieser Version erscheint d: Close. This notice will not appear again in this version.
Schließt Löcher gleich beim Einlesen. Gr: Closes holes right when reading the file. The report names large openings.
Schließt Löcher und richtet die Flächen: Closes holes and aligns the faces; the shape may change slightly at the hole edges. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
Schließt Löcher, entfernt fehlerhafte Dr: Closes holes, removes faulty triangles, aligns the outer sides and resolves overlaps.
Schließt Löcher. Große Öffnungen nennt d: Closes holes. The report names large openings.
Schließt auch Öffnungen, die eine neue g: Also closes openings that need a large new surface. Off leaves them open.
Schließt den Editor und legt das Skelett: Closes the editor and puts the armature into the history as one step.
Schließt den Halter unten: Aus der U-For: Closes the holder at the bottom: the U shape becomes a quiver, the ring a cup.
Schlitz und Rastkante sitzen wieder an d: Slot and latch edge sit at the mouth again, so the hook finds the edge and the connector holds.
Schlägt in der Normteiltabelle nach: Looks up the standard parts table
Schlüssel oder lokales Modell für den Ch: Store a key or a local model for the chat. A key goes into the keychain, never into the project file.
Schlüssellochförmige Aussparung: der Kop: A keyhole-shaped recess: the head passes through the round end, the shank holds in the slot.
Schmaler legt diese Düse keine Bahn, sie: This nozzle cannot lay a narrower line; it breaks off.
Schnapper: rastet beim Zusammendrücken e: Snap: clicks in when pressed together and holds by itself.
Schneidet den Umriss aus {name}. Danach: Cuts the outline out of {name}. Then set the depth.
Schneidet durch die ganze Höhe des Körpe: Cuts through the full height of the body; the depth setting is then ignored.
Schneidet ein Objekt an einer Ebene ab u: Cuts an object at a plane and keeps one side — the cut face is closed. For a back wall that should sit flush, or walls that should reach one height: cut away first, then offset the new face.
Schneidet ein regelmäßiges Loch-, Langlo: Cuts a regular field of holes, slots, or honeycomb openings into the drawn outline. Margins, inner contours, and excluded areas are preserved.
Schneidet eine Grundform als Tasche in e: Cuts a base shape as a pocket into a body — vertically down from the top edge, optionally all the way through. Clicking a face preselects the location. On an exact body, faces and edges are preserved; on an imported mesh, the result is a mesh.
Schneidet eine durchgängige Nut unter de: Cuts a continuous groove below the selected face along a drawing.
Schneidet eine geprüfte Dichtnut und erz: Cuts a verified seal groove and creates a separate gasket with its own material.
Schneidet eine passende Auflage für die: Cuts a matching seat for the washer.
Schneidet eine passende Tasche für ein K: Cuts a matching pocket for a ball bearing. The outside diameter and width come from the table; the fit comes from the selected material.
Schneidet einen Würfel um eine Stelle he: Cuts out a cube around a location to test the fit before printing the whole part. With both parts of a fit selected, both halves come out of the same cube.
Schneidet parallel zu dieser ebenen Fläc: Cuts parallel to this flat face instead of along an axis. The distance then counts from the face: -2 takes 2 mm off it.
Schneidet zusätzlich das Durchgangsloch: Also cuts the through hole for the screw across the part.
Schnell verringert — die Abweichung wurd: Reduced quickly — the deviation was not measured.
Schneller als die Außenwand hängen Brück: Faster than the outer wall, bridges sag.
Schnitt · Messen · Bewegen · Analyse · S: Section · Measure · Move · Analysis · Layers · Exploded · Split
Schnitttiefe ab der Zeichenfläche, auf e: Cut depth from the drawing face; on a base plane, from the top of the body.
Schraubdeckel, Steckdeckel oder ein mitg: Screw lid, push-fit lid or a hinged lid printed with its hinge.
Schraube und Mutter aus der Normteiltabe: Screw and nut from the standard parts table.
Schraubenloch mitschneiden: Cut the screw hole as well
Schraubenlöcher und Versteifung sind Bau: Screw holes and rib are parts whose dimensions come from the standard parts table and the material profile. Ctrl+K opens the catalogue.

First write what it is about.

Schritt löschen: fragt nach; abhängige S: Delete step: asks first; dependent steps are deleted with it.

Schritt {n}, Parameter „{key}“ hat einen: Step {n}, parameter “{key}” has a value that is not allowed.

Schätzt, wie viel Stützmaterial das Teil: Estimates how much support material the part needs in its current position.
Schön, dass Solidon Ihnen hilft. Ich ent: Glad Solidon is useful to you. I develop it on my own.
Sechseckfelder wie eine Bienenwabe — gle: Hexagonal cells like a honeycomb — even and technical.
Sechseckige Füllung — steif bei wenig Ma: Hexagonal infill — stiff with little material, slower to print.
Sechskantstift — hält die Teile verdrehs: Hex pin — keeps the parts from twisting.
Seine Nummer in dieser Zählung. Null hei: Its number in this count. Zero means: it is split further right away.

Seit der Anfrage sind Körper dazugekomme: Bodies have been added since the request, and the steps of the proposal would hit other ones than those it was computed for. Nothing was applied — asking the same thing again computes it on the current state.
Seit „{step}“ ist der Körper ein Dreieck: Since “{step}”, the body has been a triangle model. This tool needs true curves: undo the steps from there, apply the tool and then redo the rest.
Seite im Browser öffnen: Open the page in a browser
Seitenansicht (YZ) — stehend, von der Se: Side view (YZ) — upright, from the side
Senkrecht zu X, Y oder Z, auf Wunsch gen: Perpendicular to X, Y or Z, tilted if you like.
Senkrecht zu welcher Achse geschnitten w: Which axis the cut is perpendicular to. Z makes a horizontal cut.
Senkt den Körper bis auf das Bett; seitl: Lowers the body onto the bed; sideways it stays where it is.
Senkt die Mündung einer Bohrung an, dami: Countersinks the mouth of a bore so a screw head sits flush.
Senkung und Kopfaussparung treffen sich: Countersink and head recess meet without the former 0.01 mm ring, and the washer pocket clearance follows the part's material.
Separater Steckfuß mit Flansch, Anschlag: Separate peg foot with flange, shoulder and named peg. Material clearance is applied to the socket.
Setz unten eine Tasche für eine M3-Mutte: Put a pocket for an M3 nut into the underside
Setzen Sie einen Baustein: den Halter im: Place a part: click the bracket in the object tree, then “Parts” on the right under Selection.
Setzt Anfang und Ende der Außenwand schr: Overlaps the start and end of the outer wall gradually. This can make the seam less visible on round parts and takes a little extra printing time.
Setzt Stifte in die eine Hälfte und die: Puts pins in one half and matching holes in the other. The parts then find each other while the glue sets; the clearance comes from the material profile.
Setzt Text erhaben oder vertieft auf ein: Puts text raised or engraved on a face. The font is processed as an outline, not as a picture — the edges stay clean at any size.
Setzt das Modell auf und legt es neben d: Sets the model down next to the parts already in the project: as close to the centre of the plate as possible, on the first plate with room. Takes precedence over “Centre on the bed”.
Setzt das Modell mit seiner Unterseite a: Puts the underside of the model on the print bed.
Setzt das Modell nach dem Skalieren auf: After scaling, sets the model down next to the parts already in the project: as close to the centre of the plate as possible, on the first plate with room.
Setzt das Objekt mit seiner Unterseite a: Puts the underside of the object on the print bed.
Setzt das Teil nach dem Drehen mit seine: Places the part with its underside on the bed after rotating. Both together are one step in the history and one Ctrl+Z undoes them.
Setzt den Bezugspunkt auf die eingegeben: Sets the reference point to the entered coordinates.
Setzt den bereits angeforderten KI-Aufru: Continues the AI call that has already been requested.
Setzt den neuen Körper bündig auf die Mi: Places the new body flush with the centre of the selected face.
Setzt denselben Text auch auf die Gegens: Puts the same text on the opposite side too, where the direction leaves the body again — for flags, signs and tags.
Setzt die Haken senkrecht statt nebenein: Places the hooks vertically instead of side by side — for narrow parts that would otherwise stick out past the grid.
Setzt die Unterseite an den gewählten Pu: Places the base at the selected point or at the centre of the face.
Setzt die Unterseite auf den gewählten P: Places the base at the selected point on the face.
Setzt die Unterseite auf die Mitte der g: Places the base at the centre of the selected face.
Setzt die ausgewählten Körper gemeinsam: Places the selected bodies on the print bed together, preserving their relative positions.
Setzt einen Gewindehals auf die Öffnung: Puts a threaded neck on the opening and creates the matching screw lid. Both threads come from the same pitch, the clearance from the material profile.
Sie beschreiben ein Teil oder geben ein:
You describe a part or supply an image, and a generator turns it into a mesh: **File → Generate model.**

It is computed in a local **ComfyUI** on port 8188; if none is running, the entry stays greyed out and says why. Setting it up is described in [Setting up optional programs](manual:extras).

**What comes back is a surface, not a design**, without holes and fits and often not closed. Holes and fits are made afterwards as steps of their own.

**The supplied workflow relies on TripoSG.** Its source code and model card name the MIT licence, but part of the source code is under Tencent licences that exclude the European Union. This is being clarified. Other models have their own terms, which must be checked for the version in use.

**The result sits in the project like a file you dragged in**, because the same request gives something different after a model change. Ordinary steps such as *Repair* follow on top of it. Request and seed are kept with it; the same seed gives the same result as far as the model allows.

**The repair chain runs without asking**: closing holes, merging duplicate points, making the outsides consistent. Loading, size, repair and placing form one step: a single Ctrl+Z takes back the whole generated model, and in the history each part stays changeable on its own.
Sie erzeugen mit einem KI-System ein 3D-: You are creating a 3D model with an AI system. It may contain errors, so check the body and its printability before use.
You chose a process yourself. Picking a quality switches back to the manufacturer's matching process.
Sie interagieren mit einem KI-System. An: You are interacting with an AI system. Answers may be wrong or incomplete, and every proposal can be checked and undone in one step.
Sie ist beendet worden, die Installation: It has been stopped; the installation may be half finished.
Sie ist vielleicht verschoben worden, od: It may have been moved, or the drive is currently unavailable. Please select the file again.
Sie liegt nicht zuoberst — der Verlauf k: It is not on top — the history has no branches, so every later one is undone with it
You are looking at the sketch from the {view}. Drawing continues on the {plane}.
Sie sehen die Zeichnung aus einer freien: You are viewing the drawing from a free angle. Drawing continues on the {plane}.
Signierter Abstand der Zielmitte zum Bez: Signed distance from the target centre to the reference; not wall clearance.
Sitzspiel {clearance} mm gesamt, Übermaß: Total seat clearance: {clearance} mm; total interference at the mating profile: {press} mm. Check the fit with the selected materials.
Sitzt auf der Fläche · Griff: verschiebe: Sits on the face · Handle: move · Click: place elsewhere · Apply: run · Esc: back
Sitzt es falsch? Ein Doppelklick auf den: In the wrong place? Double-click the step in the *History* to open it again.
Sitzt in der Bohrung · Griff: verschiebe: Sits in the hole · Handle: move · Click: place elsewhere · Apply: run · Esc: back

Skaliert ein Objekt gleichmäßig oder ach: Scales an object uniformly or per axis.
Skaliert ein Objekt so, dass seine längs: Scales an object so its longest edge matches the given size. For anything whose size you know but whose factor you would have to work out first.

Skizzen liegen im Menü Erzeugen. Sie loh: Sketches are in the Create menu. They pay off wherever a dimension must still be right later.

Skizzieren — ein Umriss, der sich bemaße: Sketching — an outline you can dimension
So finden Sie den Drucker später in der: Use this name to find the printer in the list later.
So groß bricht das Gewinde durch die Wan: At this size the thread breaks through the wall of the part. With the material's minimum wall it can go up to {largest}.
So klein bricht das Gewinde in die Bohru: At this size the thread breaks into the bore in its centre. With the material's minimum wall it works from {largest}.

So passen zwei Bahnen in die dünnste Ste: This way two lines fit into the thinnest spot.
So sieht Ihr Teil aus: This is how your part will look
So stark kühlt der Lüfter kurze Schichte: How hard the fan cools short layers. Strong cooling gives sharp edges but weaker layer bonding, so use little with ABS.
So stark läuft der Lüfter bei langen Sch: How hard the fan runs on long layers, never more than the maximum. The same value holds it steady, zero turns it off there.

Solidon baut und ändert Modelle für den:
Solidon builds and changes models for the 3D printer and gets them ready to print.

* **Every step stays a number.** A hole that sits two millimetres off is moved, not drilled again.
* **The clearance of a fit comes from the material.** Measure it once, and parts you built earlier improve with it.
* **Parts instead of handwork:** nut trap, heat-set insert, latch, living hinge, magnet pocket, one click each instead of half an hour.

**Sketches are part of it.** Basic shapes and your own drawings with constraints are extruded, cut in as pockets, revolved or swept along an arc, and every dimension may be a project parameter.

**What it is not:** a slicer. Your slicer still computes the print file. No cloud, no account, no telemetry. On its own, Solidon only goes online at start-up to ask for a new version, and it sends nothing but its own version number; you can switch that off in the settings. Without a network, an account or a language model, everything except the chat keeps working.

Um so viel wird jede Stellung lockerer:: Every position becomes looser by this much: lugs narrower, notches and tracks wider, by half on each side. A negative value makes the closure tighter.
Um welche Achse der Kranz läuft. Sie geh: The axis around which the ring runs. It passes through the selected centre of rotation.
Um welche Achse die Ebene gekippt wird;: The axis the plane is tilted about; automatically one across the cutting axis. The tilt axis passes through the middle of the body at the set position.
Um welche Achse gedreht wird. Gedreht wi: Which axis to turn about. The turn happens about the centre of the feature.
Um welche Achse gedreht wird. Z dreht au: Which axis to turn about. Z spins on the bed, X and Y tip the part.
Um wie viel Grad die Ebene gegen ihre Ba: By how many degrees the plane is tilted relative to its base.
Um wie viel Grad die Flächen angestellt: By how many degrees the faces are tilted. At the neutral plane the part keeps its size; along the pull direction it narrows.
Um wie viel Grad jede Fläche flacher wir: By how many degrees each face gets shallower than the one before.
Um wie viel Grad sich das erste Teil zul: How many degrees the first part finally turns into its end position — counter-clockwise when the axis points towards you. Negative turns it the other way.
Um wie viel das Spiel von Stufe zu Stufe: By how much the clearance grows from step to step.
Um wie viel die Einlage insgesamt enger: How much narrower the liner is than the profile in total, so that it grips it elastically; zero takes the value from the material profile.

Um wie viel versetzt wird. Negativ ist n: How far to offset. Negative goes inwards.

Vergrößert Lochmaß und Langlochlänge um: Increases the opening size and slot length by the same material allowance used for drilling. Hexagonal openings keep their distance across corners.
Vergrößert das gewählte Fertigmaß um den: Increases the selected finished dimension by the value from the material profile. When off, the measured dimension remains unchanged.
Vergrößert die Bohrung um den Wert aus d: Widens the bore by the value from the material profile.
Verkleinert alle Maße gleichmäßig, auch: Shrinks all dimensions evenly, including holes and fits.
Verknüpft: {count} Abschnitte dieser Öff: Linked: {count} sections of this opening will move together.
Verknüpfte Quellen brauchen einen gespei: Linked sources need a saved project folder.
Verkürzt den Einlagenkern gegenüber der: Shortens the liner core relative to the shell so it does not contact the rear end.
Shortens the liner core relative to the shell.
Verlauf: jeder Schritt bis hierher. Dopp: History: every step so far. Double-click one to change it.
Verringert die Dreieckszahl. Die größte: Reduces the triangle count. The largest deviation from the original surface is measured and reported.
Verrunden: Klick rundet die Ecke mit Rad: Fillet: a click rounds the corner with radius {value} — typing changes it.
Verrunden: auf eine Ecke klicken, an der: Fillet: click a corner where two lines meet.
Verschiebt den bisherigen Bezugspunkt de: Moves the body's existing reference point along X.
Verschiebt die Teilung senkrecht zu ihre: Moves the split perpendicular to its line.
Verschiebt die Teilung; beide Hälften mü: Moves the split; both halves must stay in one piece and fit together.
Verschiebt ein Objekt um die angegebenen: Moves an object by the given millimetres.
Verschiebt und verteilt alle Körper der: Moves and spreads out all bodies in the scene, including those already well placed.
Verschieden große Flächen liegen auf gle: Faces of different sizes lie at the same height above a carrier face.
Verschmilzt Teile, die ineinanderstecken: Merges parts that sit inside each other. Whatever cannot be done safely stays unchanged.
Verschmilzt die gewählten Objekte zu ein: Merges the selected objects into one. The object selected first keeps its name and material; the others become part of it.
Verschoben — die Schritte danach sind ne: Moved — the steps after it have been recomputed.
Versetzen arbeitet an Linien und Kreisen: Offset works on lines and circles — an arc would become a new curve.
Versetzt ein erkanntes Merkmal an eine a: Moves a recognised feature to another place: hole, slot, peg, countersink, taper, dome, socket, bead, groove or air pocket.
Version, Rechteinhaber und die verwendet: Version, rights holder and the third-party libraries in use.
Verwendet den Mittelpunkt des gewählten: Uses the centre of the selected feature on the first body.
Verwendet diese Ecke des gemeinsamen Hül: Uses this corner of the combined bounding box of all selected bodies.
Verwendung unklar — prüfen Sie die Ausdr: Usage is unclear — check the expressions in the project.
Verwirft die gesetzten Punkte. Danach ei: Discards the placed points. You can then start a new cutting line.
Verwirft, was im Bild wartet — gerechnet: Discards what is waiting in the view — nothing is computed.
Vieleck: der zweite Klick setzt eine Eck: Polygon: the second click sets a corner. Or type the circumscribed circle.
Vieleck: erster Klick setzt die Mitte, d: Polygon: the first click sets the centre, the second a corner.
Vier Abläufe untereinander: ein fremdes: Four sequences, one below the other: adapt someone else's model (import, repair, drill, export), design it yourself (name dimensions, base body or sketch, parts, export), generate a model from text or an image (generate, repair chain, check, export) and sculpt a figure (base body, blend, sculpt, export).
Vier Aufnahmen in einer Ebene, über Kreu: Four sockets in one plane, crosswise.
Vier Bereiche, keine Betriebsarten. Rech: Four areas, no modes. The right-hand side can be hidden entirely.
Vier Schritte untereinander — Modell lad: Four steps one below the other — load model, repair, hole Ø 4.2 mm, place on bed. An arrow points at the third step: a double-click reopens it, and only the steps below it are recomputed.
Volle Schichten auf dem Bett. Sie bestim: Solid layers on the bed. They decide how smooth the underside turns out.
Volle Schichten oben schließen die Füllu: Solid top layers close the infill. How many are needed depends on layer height and infill pattern.
Voller Kopfwinkel — 90 Grad bei metrisch: Full head angle — 90 degrees for metric countersunk screws.
Voller Winkel zwischen Bohrung und Aufwe: Full angle between the bore and widened section. 180 degrees creates a flat shoulder.
From the floor upward, without a threshold.
Vom Start bis zum Druck: From the start to the print
Vom fertigen Modell zur Druckdatei, ohne: From the finished model to the print file, without leaving Solidon.
Vom leeren Projekt zur fertigen Platte,: From an empty project to the finished plate, with a ready-made part for the screw hole.
Von Ihrer Formgrenze bleiben {value} für: Of your shape limit, {value} is reserved for meshing the rebuilt model. The flat triangles of the original model count towards the deviation.
Von Mitte zu Mitte zweier benachbarter P: From centre to centre of two neighbouring places.
Von Mitte zu Mitte, bei der linearen Art: Centre to centre, for the linear kind. The circular one counts the angle.
Von Zelle zu Zelle. Kleiner heißt mehr S: From cell to cell. Smaller means more struts and more material.
Von dem Körper bleibt nichts übrig — das: Nothing is left of the body — the tool covers it completely. Check size and position.
Von der Seite eingeschoben oder von unte: Pushed in from the side or laid in from below.
Von der heruntergeladenen Datei bis zur: From the downloaded file to the print file.
Von oben eingehängt, durch die Zunge geh: Hooked in from the top, held by the tongue — pressed through the slot to release.
Von {expected} Schrift stehen nur {shown: Of {expected} of lettering, only {shown} stands above the face, and the rest is inside the body. Usually the direction points inward.
Vor diesem Schritt einfügen statt ans En: Insert before this step instead of at the end
Vorderansicht (XZ) — stehend, von vorn: Front view (XZ) — upright, from the front
Vorhandene Absturzprotokolle werden eben: Existing crash logs are also displayed and attached.
Vorn im Dialog: At the front of the dialog
Vorschau abgebrochen — das Modell bleibt: Preview cancelled — the model stays as it was. Changing a value computes it again.
Vorschau nicht verfügbar — ändern Sie ei: Preview unavailable — change a value to calculate it again.
Vorschau nicht verfügbar. Die Werte bear: Preview unavailable. Edit the values and place again.
Vorschau unvollständig — beim Übernehmen: Preview incomplete — the exact result is computed on Apply
Vorschau wird aufbereitet — sichtbar ist: Preparing preview — the previous model is still shown.
Vorschau — am Volumen ändert sich nichts: Preview — the volume does not change
Vorschau — das Netz ändert sich, das Vol: Preview — the mesh changes, the volume does not
Vorschau — der Name ändert sich, die For: Preview — the name changes, the shape does not
Vorschlag, Fehler oder Frage an den Supp: Suggestion, bug or question to support — with picture and session if you like.
Level, parallel to the print bed.
Wand und Überhang gelten nur für diese D: Wall thickness and overhang apply only to these printing conditions:
Wand von Aufnahme und Kragen, und mindes: Wall of socket and collar; every web between slots stays at least this wide.
Wand zwischen Durchgang und Schaft. Der: Wall between passage and shank. The passage is narrower by two walls.
Wand- und Bodenstärke der Segmente — so: Wall and floor thickness of the segments — the stop in the middle is this deep.
Wandbahnen mit fester Breite — vorherseh: Wall lines of fixed width — predictable and proven.
Wandbahnen mit veränderlicher Breite — f: Wall lines of varying width — fills thin spots better.
Wandelt die exakte Geometrie in ein Drei: Converts the exact geometry into a triangle mesh. Further edits such as chamfers and fillets operate on the mesh. Undo restores the exact body.
Wall thickness of the sleeve or the insert.
Wandstärke des Behälters und seines Eins: Wall thickness of the container and its insert.
Wandstärke einer neuen Einlage, senkrech: Wall thickness of a new liner, measured perpendicular; required minimum wall for a replacement.
Wandstärke zwischen Gegenprofil und Auße: Wall thickness between the mating profile and outer seat, measured perpendicular.
Wann die Verpackung dieser Spule geöffne: When this spool's packaging was opened.
Warten Sie, bis er fertig ist, oder brec: Wait until it has finished, or cancel it.
Wartet auf die feine Berechnung des Mode: Waiting for the fine calculation of the model …
Wartet auf die lokale KI — ein anderer L: Waiting for the local AI — another task is currently using the graphics card.
Warum jeder Schritt änderbar bleibt und: Why every step stays changeable and what holds a transaction together.
Was Messen, Schnitt, Analysekarten und S: What measuring, section, analysis maps and layer preview show before you print.
What you would keep exactly as it is.
Was Sie gesucht und nicht gefunden haben: What you looked for and did not find, or what took longer than it needed to.
Was Solidon außerdem benutzen kann, wo e: What else Solidon can use, where it sits and how it gets here.
Was Solidon beim Einlesen selbst reparie: What Solidon repairs on its own when reading a file, and how you fix the rest.
Was Solidon im Modell erkennt: What Solidon recognises in a model
Was Solidon in einem geladenen Modell wi: What Solidon recognises again in a loaded model, and what a click on it makes possible.
Was an einem Resin-Drucker anders ist, u: What is different about a resin printer, and what Solidon leaves out there.
Was aus der Zeichnung wird, entscheidet: What becomes of the drawing is decided after the drawing.
Was der Clip halten soll — Kabel oder Sc: What the clip should hold — cable or tube from the table.
Was die Anwendung sagt, wenn etwas nicht: What the application says when something does not work — word for word, so it can be looked up. An error never ends in “failed” here: every message comes with at least one way forward.
Was die Bereiche des Fensters können, üb: What the areas of the window can do, beyond what you see.
Was die Position bedeutet: die Mündung d: What the position means: the mouth of the bore being countersunk, or the spot itself. A clicked bore reports its centre — countersinking there creates a cavity instead of a chamfer.
Was die Position bedeutet: die Mündung,: What the position means: the mouth where the plug starts, or its centre. For a through plug it makes no difference.
What the position means: the opening where the bore starts, or its centre. A widened section starts at the opening.
Was ein Kilogramm kostet. Nur für die Ko: What a kilogram costs. For the cost estimate only.
Was einstellbar sein soll, sagt der, der: What should be adjustable is decided by whoever built the part.
Was fehlt, was hakt, was besser sein kön: What is missing, what snags, what could be better — write it down. The message goes to {address}; only what is shown below is sent.
Was gezeichnet war, ist jetzt ein Schrit: What was drawn is now a step in the history.
Was haben Sie getan, was ist passiert, w: What did you do, what happened, what did you expect?
Was hat gefehlt oder gestört?: What was missing or in the way?
Was hier steht, steht beim Färben zur Wa: What is listed here is offered when colouring.
Was in den Feldern darüber keinen Platz: Whatever did not fit in the fields above.
Was mit den übrigen Abschnitten eines Ho: What happens to the remaining sections of a cavity — a countersink above the selected hole, for instance. With “Ask first” you decide as soon as the case arises.
Was nicht durch die Leitung geht: What does not go down the wire
Was sich hier tun lässt, steht oben bei: What you can do here is above, with the dimensions.
Was sich in dieser und den vorigen Versi: What changed in this version and the ones before it.
Was sich in {app} geändert hat. Sie benu: What changed in {app}. You are using {version}.
Was zusätzlich aufs Bett kommt, damit da: What goes onto the bed in addition, so the part holds. With automatic, the slicer decides by part and material. Brim lays down a rim, raft a base; skirt does not touch the part and only keeps the nozzle flowing.
Wechselt das Druckziel; alle Druckprüfun: Changes the print target; all print checks are assessed again for the new printer.
Wechsle Drucker oder Material des Projek: Switch the printer or material of the project. Tolerances are references into the material profile and are recalculated with it.
Weg 3: ein Modell aus Text oder Bild erz: Way 3: generate a model from text or an image
Weiche, wellenförmige Rillen — dekorativ: Soft, wavy grooves — decorative and pleasant to hold.
Weiches Filament staucht sich bei mehr T: Soft filament buckles in the drive at higher speed.
Weisen Sie den neuen Einlagen ein Filame: Assign a filament for the selected material to the new liners.
Weite der Öffnungen. Groß genug, dass ni: Width of the openings. Wide enough for unused material to come out.
Weiter ziehen oder den Durchmesser in de: Drag further or make the diameter in the bar smaller.
Weitere Achse der Richtung — siehe Richt: Another axis of the direction — see Direction X.
Weitere Achse des Orts — siehe Position: Another axis of the position — see Position X.
Weitere Arten, aus der Zeichnung einen K: More ways to turn the drawing into a body.
Weitere Farbe — für zwei- bis vierfarbig: Another colour — for two- to four-colour filament.
Weitere Radien entlang der Kante, je als: Further radii along the edge, each as “position:radius” with the position in per cent of the length from the start — “50:4” for 4 mm in the middle, say, several separated by spaces. Only the start and end radius can be bound to a project dimension, intermediate points are fixed numbers.
Welche Anleitung zu Ihrem Vorhaben passt: Which guide fits what you want to do, and what to know beforehand.
Welche Druckplatte aufliegt, sagt das Pr: The profile does not say which build plate is fitted.
Welche Fläche wandert. Beim Anklicken st: Which face moves. Clicking a face fills this in. If left empty, the legacy direction-based method applies only to an exact body: every face pointing in the specified direction moves.
Welche Flächen angestellt werden. Ohne A: Which faces are drafted. Without a selection, every wall along the pull direction — for “upwards”, every vertical one.
Welche Hälfte die Stifte trägt: A liegt: Which half carries the pins: A lies on the smaller side of the plane, B on the larger. Automatic splitting picks the side whose halves need less support together.
Welche Kanten gemeint sind — senkrechte,: Which edges are meant — upright, level, top, bottom, all, or picked one by one. A round rim only belongs if it lies flat; pick a hole in a side wall on its own.
Welche Körper der Datei übernommen werde: Which bodies of the file are taken over. Empty reads the file as one body, as in older projects.
Welche Seite der Ebene stehen bleibt. Di: Which side of the plane stays. The other one is removed.
Welche Seite offen bleibt, wenn aus eine: Which side stays open when a through hole becomes a blind hole. With “Ask first” you decide as soon as the case arises.
Welche Senkung oder Ansenkung zu dieser: Which countersink or counterbore belongs to this hole cannot be read unambiguously here. Under “More settings”, choose the shape “Plain pin”.
Welche Stellen soll man später anklicken: Which places should be clickable later?
Welche Tasten die Operationen führen. Wi: Which keys trigger the operations. Takes effect on the next start.
Welche der übereinanderliegenden Flächen: Which of the overlapping surfaces do you mean?
Welche geschlossene Öffnung soll den Dic: Which closed opening should define the seal path?
Welcher Grauwert die Fläche in Ruhe läss: Which grey value leaves the surface alone. Zero only adds, 0.5 raises and lowers — the difference between a stamp and an embossing.
Welcher Punkt beim Skalieren stehen blei: Which point stays put while scaling.
Welcher Slicer die Druckdatei rechnet. D: Which slicer computes the print file. The choice is remembered and applies next time too; the profiles below follow it.
Welches Filament die Fläche bekommt. Im: Which filament the face gets. In the 3MF it stays assigned to the same colour-change position.
Welches Filament diese Fläche bekommt. D: Which filament this face gets. The pre-selection is below — what the body already carries is at the top.
Welches Material dieses Teil ist. Leer h: Which material this part is made of. Empty means: the project's.
Welches Merkmal meint die Passung {name}: Which feature does the fit {name} mean?
Welches Modell aus dem Archiv soll hinei: Which model from the archive should be brought in?
Welches Modell aus einem ZIP-Archiv, Nam: Which model from a ZIP archive, named as inside it
Which model does this job. “Automatic” takes whatever fits.
Welches Muster aufgebracht wird. Rändel: Which pattern is applied. Knurling gives grip, honeycomb and rib are decoration, Voronoi and noise hide the layer lines.
Weniger Beschleunigung hält die Kontur d: Less acceleration keeps the contour of the fits accurate.
Weniger Dreiecke: Feine Rundungen und Sc: Fewer triangles: fine curves and text become more angular, the dimensions stay.
Weniger Farben als Filamente — mehr gibt: Fewer colours than filaments — the model has no more to give.
Weniger Teile gehen auf diesem Drucker n: This printer cannot do it with fewer parts.
Wenn an den Wänden unten oder oben Rundu: When the walls carry fillets at the bottom or top. Then choose only walls without a fillet.
Wenn an einer Ecke drei ungleiche Fasen: When three unequal chamfers meet at a corner and its shape matters. On a mesh the corner closes flat, otherwise curved.
Wenn beide Seiten gebraucht werden, denn: When both sides are needed, because the other one goes, holes included. Use “Split at a plane” for that.
Wenn das Teil nicht auf das Bett passt: When the part does not fit the bed
Wenn der Deckel dicht schließen muss, de: When the lid must seal, because the dial only rests on top. Print both parts lying flat.
Wenn der Verschluss dicht sein oder Rütt: When the closure must seal or withstand shaking. That needs a seal and a detent.
Wenn die 3D-Maus nicht reagiert: When the 3D mouse does not respond
Wenn die Rundung eine echte Kurve sein m: When the fillet must be a true curve. On a mesh it is made of straight segments, finer than any nozzle.
Wenn die Segmente einrasten sollen, denn: When the segments should snap together, because the joint only keeps them aligned. Add a latch to each segment for that.
Wenn ein Teil oft abgenommen wird, denn: When a part is taken off often, because the latch tongue must be pressed through the slot. Then switch off “Latch tongue”.
Wenn eine Passung nicht mehr passt: When a fit no longer fits
Wer kalibriert, verbessert damit auch Te: Calibrating also improves parts that were built earlier.
Werkzeug schließen, sonst Auswahl eine S: Close tool, otherwise selection back one level
Werkzeuge unter dem Modell: Schnitt, Mes: Tools below the model: Section, Measure, Move and more.
Werkzeugleiste: neu, öffnen, speichern,: Toolbar: new, open, save, insert model, draw, sculpt, armature.
Werkzeugnummer außerhalb der Filamentpal: Tool number outside the filament palette
Wert aus dem erzeugenden Schritt. Die vo: Value from the creating step. The existing surface may differ.
Wert in die Oberseite gravieren: Engrave the value on the top
Werte, Herkunft und Schritt des Befunds: Values, source and step of the finding
Wickelt das Bild um die Achse — für Bech: Wraps the image around the axis — for cups, tubes and round housings.
Widersprüchliche Farbzuordnungen auf der: Conflicting colour assignments on the same face
Widersprüchliche Werkzeugzuordnungen für: Conflicting tool assignments for the same object
Wie breit das Auge ist, längs der Drehac: How wide the eye is, measured along the axis of rotation.
Wie breit das Langloch wird — die zwei K: How wide the slot becomes — the two clicks set its length.
Wie breit das Musterfeld auf der Fläche: How wide the pattern field becomes.
Wie breit der Bügel ist, längs des Kabel: How wide the clamp is, measured along the cable.
Wie breit der Fuß aufsteht. Breiter kipp: How wide the foot stands. Wider tips later.
Wie breit der angelegte Rand ist. Mehr h: How wide the rim laid down is. More holds better and has to be cut off afterwards.
Wie breit die Kehle zwischen beiden Körp: How wide the fillet between the two bodies grows. Zero gives the ordinary union. It bridges a gap from about three times its width.
Wie breit die Schelle ist, längs des Roh: How wide the clamp is, measured along the pipe.
Wie breit dieser Drucker eine Bahn legt: How wide this printer lays a line — usually a little more than the nozzle diameter. Each step of the ladder is one line thicker than the last.
Wie breit eine Bahn gelegt wird. Etwas m: How wide a line is laid down. A little more than the nozzle diameter is normal: more carries better, less draws finer.
As the eye sees it: distant things get smaller.
Wie das Filament heißt. Leer nimmt „Fila: What the filament is called. Empty uses “Filament” and the number.
Wie das Objekt im Baum heißt. Leer heißt: What the object is called in the tree. Empty means Solidon picks a name.
Wie das Objekt im Baum heißt. Leer übern: What the object is called in the tree. Empty takes the file name.
Wie das rechteckige Bild auf den Körper: How the rectangular image gets onto the body: from above, wrapped around the axis or over the sphere.
Wie der Halter befestigt wird: zwei Schl: How the holder is mounted: two keyholes on the back (one in the middle on a narrow holder), two tabs with countersunk screw holes, two hooks for the pegboard, or a clamp that grips over the edge of a board. Screw and pegboard dimensions come from the standard parts table.
Wie dicht die Stütze steht, von 1 bis 10: Support density, from 1 to 100 %. Denser supports carry more weight and are harder to remove. To print without supports, choose “None” under “Supports”.
Wie dick der Winkel ist, längs der Kante: How thick the gusset is, measured along the edge. Zero means as thick as the rib would be — two thirds of the wall.
Wie dick die Buchstaben werden. Zum Aufk: How thick the letters become. A few tenths are enough for gluing on.
Wie dick die Deckelplatte wird — der Kra: How thick the lid plate becomes — the collar below it comes from the cavity.
Wie dick die Leiste wird — der Radius de: How thick the strip becomes — the radius of the round rod lying on the edge.
Wie dick die Platte ist, über die die Kl: How thick the board is that the clamp grips over — shelf, tabletop, door. The gap has exactly this size.
Wie dick die Stege werden. Unter zwei Ba: How thick the struts become. Below two lines the printer will not print them — then the operation says so instead of trying.
Wie dick die Wand ist, auf der die Tülle: How thick the wall is that the barb sits on. The passage goes this deep so that it is open on the other side.
Wie dick die Wand wird. Unter zwei Bahne: How thick the wall becomes. Below two lines it breaks easily — what that means for this material is in the report.
How thick the remaining wall becomes. More than half the body is impossible — nothing would be left to hollow.
Wie dick jede Schicht ist. Weniger heißt: How thick each layer is. Less means finer and slower: 0.2 mm is the everyday case, 0.12 mm for visible parts, 0.28 mm for blocks.
Wie die Bahnen einer Wand verteilt werde: How the lines of a wall are distributed. Arachne fills narrow ribs that do not match a whole number of line widths; classic works with equal widths and fills the rest.
Wie die Füllung gelegt wird. Gyroid träg: How the infill is laid. Gyroid carries equally in all directions, grid is faster, honeycomb lies in between.
Wie fein die neue Fläche wird. Kürzer he: How fine the new surface becomes. Shorter means rounder and slower to compute.
Wie fein gerechnet wird. Kleiner heißt g: How finely it is computed. Smaller means more accurate and markedly slower — edges below this spacing are lost.
Wie groß der Ausschnitt wird. Groß genug: How big the cut-out gets. Big enough that the fit has material around it.
Wie gut kommen Sie mit dem Programm zure: How well are you getting on with the program?
Wie hart der Drucker beschleunigt. Wenig: How hard the printer accelerates. Less means cleaner corners and more time.
Wie heiß die Düse ist. Zu kalt heißt sch: How hot the nozzle is. Too cold means weak layer bonding, too hot brings strings and soft overhangs.
Wie hoch das Muster steht oder wie tief: How far the pattern stands out or cuts in. Shallower than one layer it disappears when printed.
Wie hoch das Musterfeld wird. Es sitzt m: How tall the pattern field becomes. It sits centred on the chosen spot.
Wie hoch das Relief wird — der Abstand z: How tall the relief becomes — the distance between black and white.
Wie hoch der Gewindehals wird. Zwei Umdr: How tall the threaded neck becomes. Two turns hold, three sit tight.
Wie hoch der Körper gezogen wird, vom Dr: How high the body is raised, from the print bed upwards.
Wie hoch der Rand vorn über die Ablage s: How high the lip at the front stands above the shelf. Zero is the L shape; with a lip it becomes the Z shape, from which nothing slides off.
Wie hoch er trägt — bei der Tasche: wie: How high it lifts — for the pocket: how deep the rubber foot sinks in.
Wie im CAD — mittlere Taste dreht, recht: Like a CAD program — the middle button rotates, right zooms
Wie in Bambu Studio, Orca und PrusaSlice: Like Bambu Studio, Orca and PrusaSlicer — left rotates
Wie in Blender — links wählt, mittlere T: Like Blender — left selects, the middle button rotates
Wie in Cura — links wählt, rechts dreht: Like Cura — left selects, right rotates
Wie lang die Kanten danach ungefähr über: Roughly how long the edges are everywhere afterwards. Shorter means finer and a denser mesh — and finer is only needed where shaping happens later.
Wie lange eine Schicht mindestens dauert: The minimum time a layer takes. On small cross-sections the printer slows down so the previous layer can set.
Wie läuft es mit Solidon?: How are you getting on with Solidon?
Wie man mit dem Chat spricht, was er sie: How to talk to the chat, what it sees and what becomes of a proposal.
Wie oft die Höhen über die Nachbarn gemi: How often the heights are averaged over their neighbours. Takes hard edges out of an image drawn too sharply for printing.
Wie schnell zurückgezogen wird. Zu schne: How fast it is pulled back. Too fast grinds the drive wheel into the filament, too slow draws strings.
Wie tief Schraubenkopf und Unterlegschei: How deeply the screw head and washer sink into the part.
Wie tief der Gegenstand auf der Ablage s: How deep the object sits on the shelf, up to the lip. The clearance is added.
Wie tief der Kragen axial einfährt, bevo: How deep the collar goes in axially before it is turned; this much wall stands above the turning slot.
How deep the screw head sinks in.
Wie tief der Übergang von der Oberkante: How deep the transition reaches from the top edge; the lower outline lies there.
Wie tief die Aussparung ins Material geh: How deep the recess goes into the material.
Wie tief die Bohrung von ihrer Mündung a: How deep the hole reaches into the material from its mouth. Zero drills right through; empty leaves the depth as it is.
Wie tief die Einlage reicht. Drei Schich: How deep the inlay goes. Three layers cover the colour underneath.
Wie tief die Stange in jede Aufnahme ges: How deep the rod goes into each socket until it reaches the stop. Deeper holds better against tilting.
Wie tief die Tasche von ihrer Oberkante: How deep the pocket cuts down from its top edge.
Wie tief gebohrt wird. Mehr als die Wand: How deep to drill. More than the wall thickness gives a through hole.
Wie viel Material die Düse je Sekunde sc: How much material the nozzle manages per second. This limit caps every speed that asks for more.
Wie viel Material im Inneren steht. 15 %: How much material stands inside. 15% is the everyday case, 40% for load, 0% gives a hollow body.
Wie viele Ausfertigungen es danach gibt,: How many copies there are afterwards, the original included. A single one is not a pattern.
How many copies there are afterwards, the original included. Two means one copy.
How many lines thick the outer skin is. Two hold the shape, three or four carry load.
Wie viele Düsen der Drucker zugleich füh: How many nozzles the printer runs at once. A changer unit does not count — it purges at every filament change.
Wie viele Ecken das Vieleck bekommt — dr: How many corners the polygon gets — three to twelve.
Wie viele Haken. Zwei nebeneinander halt: How many hooks. Two side by side keep a part from twisting; one is enough for something light.
Wie viele Hüllflächen als Grundfläche ge: How many convex hull faces are checked as a base. The best orientations are then compared using layer analysis.
Wie viele Löcher zwischen zwei Haken lie: How many holes lie between two hooks. One means every hole, two means every second. Wide parts tip between two hooks only forty millimetres apart — further out they carry more steadily.
Wie viele Nocken gleichmäßig verteilt si: How many lugs sit evenly spaced. Three stand like a tripod.
Wie viele Paare gedruckt werden. Vier re: How many pairs get printed. Four is usually enough to bracket the value.
Wie viele Plätze das Muster hat, die Que: How many places the pattern has, the source included.
Wie viele Raststellungen gleichmäßig ver: How many detent positions are evenly spaced. In the first everything is closed; each further one uncovers one opening.
Wie viele Runden neben dem Teil gelegt w: How many loops are laid beside the part without touching it.
Wie viele Schichten die Unterlage hat, a: How many layers the base has that the part stands on.
Wie viele Widerhaken hintereinander auf: How many barbs sit one after another on the shank.
Wie viele Wände nebeneinander stehen, je: How many walls stand side by side, each one line width thicker than the last.
Wie warm das Bett ist. Die passende Temp: How warm the bed is. A suitable temperature helps adhesion and can reduce lifting at the corners.
Wie weit das Fenster der Scheibe und jed: How far the window of the dial and each opening of the guide extend.
Wie weit das Filament zurückgezogen wird: How far the filament is pulled back before the nozzle travels empty. The remedy against strings.
Wie weit das Teil nach dem Einhängen abs: How far the part drops after it is hung up.
Wie weit der Arm heraussteht, beziehungs: How far the arm sticks out, or how deep the pocket goes. It also sets the arm thickness: a tenth of it.
Wie weit der Bogen führt — 90 Grad ist e: How far the bend goes — 90 degrees is a right-angle pipe elbow.
Wie weit der Bogen führt — 90 Grad lenkt: How far the arc leads — 90 degrees turns the channel from vertical to horizontal.
Wie weit der Gegenstand von der Wand abs: How far the object stands out from the wall. The clearance is added.
Wie weit der Haken vorsteht — also wie v: How far the hook protrudes — that is, how far it travels when snapping in.
Wie weit der Kragen in die Öffnung reich: How far the collar reaches into the opening. Zero means a flat lid without one.
Wie weit der Schlauch aufgeschoben wird,: How far the hose is pushed on, from the collar to the tip.
How far the slot reaches outwards. Zero means: the pocket only.
Wie weit der Steckdeckel in die Öffnung: How far the push-fit lid extends into the opening.
Wie weit der Stift heraussteht, beziehun: How far the pin stands out, or how deep the hole goes.
Wie weit der Winkel an beiden Wänden ent: How far the gusset reaches along both walls.
Wie weit der mitgedruckte Deckel aufgekl: How far the printed-in-place lid is made opened. At zero it lies on the rim and fuses with it during printing.
Wie weit der vordere Anschlag über den S: How far the front stop extends beyond the seat.
Wie weit die Achse von der Fläche wegste: How far the axis stands off the face — that is the pivot.
Wie weit die Dreiecke von der echten Flä: How far the triangles may deviate from the real surface.
Wie weit die Düse anhebt, bevor sie leer: How far the nozzle lifts before it travels empty. It then does not bump into what is already printed.
Wie weit die Ebene parallel zu sich vers: How far the plane is moved parallel to itself, measured from the face, edge or points. At a face, -2 takes off two millimetres.
Wie weit die Fase auf der zweiten Fläche: How far the chamfer cuts the second face back.
Wie weit die Fase die Kante zurücknimmt: How far the chamfer cuts the edge back — on both faces, or on the reference face with two distances and with distance and angle.
Wie weit die Feder in der Nut entlangläu: How far the tongue runs along the slot. Longer holds more.
How far the surface may travel for it. Zero leaves the shape untouched; only above that do the needlessly fine spots disappear as well.
Wie weit die Fläche wandert. Positiv nac: How far the face travels. Positive outwards, negative inwards — the same tool for both.
Wie weit die Lasche von der Fläche abste: How far the tab stands off the face, to the tip of the round end. Zero means: long enough for the washer to fit beside the face.
Wie weit die Nase hinter die Lochwand gr: How far the nose reaches behind the pegboard. Zero means two thirds of the pegboard thickness.
Wie weit die Nase vorsteht. Das ist der: How far the latch protrudes. That is the travel the counterpart has to spring over.
Wie weit die Rippe an der Wand entlanglä: How far the rib runs along the wall.
Wie weit die Trennebene vom Nullpunkt en: How far the split plane sits from the origin, measured along the split direction. The drawn line fills the number in; changing it later moves the cut without turning it.
Wie weit die Zeichnung in die Höhe gezog: How far the drawing gets pulled up.
Wie weit die Zinken von der Rückwand rei: How far the prongs reach from the back plate — for a round handle, its diameter. At least half the width.
Wie weit die neue Ebene über der Basis l: How far the new plane lies above the base. Negative puts it below.
Wie weit die neutrale Ebene vom Anfang d: How far the neutral plane lies from the start of the part, measured along the pull direction. Below it the part gets wider, above it narrower.
Wie weit die Öffnung je Seite enger ist: How much narrower the opening is than the cable, per side — that is what makes the clip hold. Zero means a fifth of the diameter.
Wie weit diese Runden vom Teil entfernt: How far these loops lie from the part.
Wie weit ein Schub die Ansicht bewegt. L: How far one push moves the view. Left is fine, right is brisk.
Wie weit ein einzelner Zug die Fläche ve: How far a single stroke moves the surface.
Wie weit eine Ecke des Netzes neben ihre: How far a corner of the mesh may lie off its face. Larger accepts coarse meshes.
Wie weit erhaben oder wie tief eingelass: How far raised or how deep engraved.
Wie weit gedreht wird, bis die Nocke am: How far it turns until the lug reaches the end of the slot.
How far to turn, in degrees.
Wie weit jede Fläche frei hinaussteht. Z: How far each face reaches out unsupported. Too short and the printer forgives everything.
Wie weit jede Lasche von der Achse wegst: How far each leaf reaches from the axle — the lever of the joint.
Wie weit jeder Widerhaken je Seite über: How far each barb stands out beyond the hose on each side. More holds tighter and is harder to push on.
Wie weit jeder der beiden Flügel vom Sch: How far each of the two leaves reaches away from the hinge.
Wie weit jedes Segment in die Naht greif: How far each segment reaches into the joint.
Wie weit sie von der Wand absteht. Das i: How far it stands off the wall. That is what gives it stiffness.
Wie weit um die Achse gedreht wird. 360: How far around the axis it turns. 360 closes the body.
How far around the axis the cut goes. 360 runs all the way round, less gives a partial groove.
Wie weit vor der Endlage geprüft wird. S: How far ahead of the final position to check. As long as the section where the parts engage, plus some run-up.
Wiederholt erkannte Merkmale in einer Re: Repeats recognised features in a row, on a circle or mirrored: hole, countersink, slot, peg, taper, dome, bead or groove. The source stays in charge — if its size changes in the history, the copies follow.
Wird abgebrochen — der laufende Schritt: Cancelling — the current step is finishing.
Wird aus einer Durchgangsbohrung ein Sac: If a through hole becomes a blind hole, you are asked which side stays open.
Wird aus {expression} gerechnet. Freigeg: Computed from {expression}. Once exposed, this value loses its formula: the part gets its own field instead, which no longer follows along.
Wird die Sicherung nicht geöffnet, wird: If the backup is not opened, it is discarded.
Wird flach aufgelegt, ohne sich der Form: Is laid on flat, without bending to the shape.
Wird geschlossen, sobald die laufenden A: This window will close when the ongoing tasks have finished.

Wirkt nur, wenn „{field}“ nicht angehakt: Only takes effect while “{field}” is not ticked.
Wischt die Düse am Teil ab, bevor sie we: Wipes the nozzle on the part before it travels away. Fewer blobs, a little more time.
Wo Stützen ansetzen dürfen. Nur vom Bett: Where supports may start. From the bed only leaves the model itself untouched; everywhere also supports in the middle of it and leaves marks.
Wo das Teil sein Maß behält: am Anfang d: Where the part keeps its size: at the start of the pull direction — at the bottom for “upwards” — at its end, or at a chosen height.
Wo der Baustein sitzt, gemessen im Koord: Where the part sits, measured in the object's coordinates. A clicked face fills the value in itself.
Where the channel starts, in X.
Where the channel starts, in Y.
Wo der Würfel sitzt: an der Position unt: Where the cube sits: at the position below or, with two selected parts of a fit, where they come closest. The spot found is kept as the position.
Wo der Übergang oben beginnt, gemessen s: Where the transition starts at the top, measured perpendicular to the drawing plane. Zero means: at the top of the body.
Wo die Mitte des Modells liegt. Die frei: Where the centre of the model lies. The free spot is found once and kept here; empty finds it again.
Wo die Naht jeder Schicht sitzt — die St: Where the seam of each layer sits — the place where a line begins and ends. Aligned gives a visible line, random spreads it out.
Wo die Operation ansetzt. Die Zahlen ste: Where the operation applies. The numbers are under “More settings”.
Wo die Schnittebene liegt, auf dieser Ac: Where the cutting plane lies, measured on that axis. The number stays editable: a double-click on the step moves the cut.
Wo die Schnittfläche sichtbar bleibt, de: Where the cut face stays visible, because the seam lies on a plane. Better to split where an edge already runs.
Wo die Schrift sitzt. Eine angeklickte F: Where the text sits. A clicked face fills in place and direction itself.
Wo die Spiegelebene liegt: in der Mitte: Where the mirror plane lies: at the centre of the object, at the origin or at the print bed.
Wo die Tasche oben beginnt, gemessen sen: Where the pocket starts at the top, measured perpendicular to the drawing plane. Zero means: at the top of the body.
Wo diese einzelne Spule liegt, etwa Schr: Where this individual spool is stored, such as a cupboard or box.
Wo eine Metallschraube greifen soll, den: Where a metal screw has to bite, because the crest is flattened for the printer. For load-bearing joints, use an insert or a nut trap.
Wo eine Teilnut beginnt, um die Achse ge: Where a partial groove starts, measured around the axis. No effect at 360 degrees.
Wo es auf das Außenmaß ankommt, denn ein: Where the outer size matters, because a bead protrudes beyond the body. Faces and edges become triangles in the process.
Wo es auf ein Maß ankommt, denn die Rund: Where a dimension matters, because the curve is calculated from the existing triangles. Draw it in the sketch instead.

Wo fange ich an? Geführte Touren, Schrit: Where do I start? Guided tours, step by step.
Wo sich die ersten beiden gewählten Teil: Where the first two selected parts come closest — that is where the fit sits.

Wo was steht, zeigt [Das Fenster auf ein:
[The window at a glance](manual:window-overview) shows where everything is. This page says what the areas can do.

![](figure:window)

**The project header** names the project, the printer and the filaments in use. A click on the printer picks a different one for this project. If the project has several plates, the plate chooser next to it sets the view to one of them.

**At the top, the toolbar.** *Draw* swings the view square onto the drawing plane, and the model steps back, translucent. *Sculpt* and *Armature* need a selected body and say so before you click. Escape gets you out of every tool.

**Below the model, the tool strip:** *Section*, *Measure*, *Move*, *Analysis*, *Layers*, *Exploded* and *Split*, in that order on Alt+1 to Alt+7. Only *Move* and *Split* change the model, each as a step in the history; the others only look.

**On the left** are Objects, Parameters, History and Filaments, each section collapsible. Under every body, the object tree lists what the recognition found in it.

**The mouse in the view.** A left click selects, a left drag pans the view. Press the left button on a selected body and you move the body. A right drag rotates, the held wheel tilts up and down, scrolling zooms towards the pointer. Home (*Fit to view*) frames the selected body, or the whole scene when nothing is selected.

**Flying with the keyboard.** W and S go forward and back, A and D sideways, Q and E tilt. While the key is held, the view flies evenly, and unlike the zoom it flies right through the part. The keys work once the view has the focus, that is after one click into it.

**Used to something else? Switch.** The settings offer four more layouts after Cura, Bambu Studio, Orca and PrusaSlicer, CAD and Blender; there the left button selects again, and the keyboard does not fly. A 3D mouse (SpaceMouse) drives the same camera: push moves the part, twist turns it, pull brings it closer, and a device button fits everything into view. Speed and direction are in the settings once a device has been seen. If it does not respond, see [When the 3D mouse does not respond](manual:spacemouse-access).

**Next to it, three tabs:** *Selection*, *Report* and *Chat*. While drawing, a tab for the constraints joins them, during the tour one for its steps. F9 hides the whole area; the model then gets the space, and the status bar counts the open findings. Both panels move by the handle at their top right, with the mouse or the arrow keys. A double-click on the handle or *View → Panels back to their place* puts them back.

**Selection** comes to the front as soon as you click something in the view or in the object tree. At the top are the dimensions of what you clicked, below them the matching actions, the most common first: with two bodies *Unite*, *Subtract* and *Intersection*, with one *Drill a bore*, *Hollow out*, *Split at a plane* and *Rebuild model*. All the others follow in groups, and a search field finds each one. With nothing selected, it holds the actions for all bodies, such as *Orient for printing*. The *Parts* button opens the catalogue. What the tab shows on a feature is described in [What Solidon recognises in a model](manual:features).

**The report** does not jump to the front when a new message appears. Its tab counts errors (X) and warnings (!) and flashes for a few seconds, red for an error, yellow for a warning. It stays tinted until you have looked at the report. Identical messages share one line with their count in brackets in front; a click selects all the parts concerned, and an action asks which of them it should apply to.

**There is no menu for the selection.** The menu bar keeps what works without a selection. Keyboard shortcuts still apply, and the command palette finds every action by its name, with the shortcut beside it.

**There are no modes** and no workbenches to switch between. There is the scene.

Woher die Maße kommen, wenn ein Baustein: Where the dimensions come from when a part places a screw hole, a nut trap or a thread: from the metric series from M1.6 to M64. A printable internal thread of a size fits a hole between its tap drill hole and its nominal size. If none fits, the thread takes a custom size whose tap drill hole is the hole. Screw hole, nut trap, screw and nut also take any diameter under *Custom size*; their dimensions are then derived from the neighbouring standard sizes and are not standardised, and the report says so. Two ways change the model itself: *Move* in the tool strip below the view, and assigning filament on the right under *Selection*. Every drag and every assignment is a step of its own in the history, with numbers you can change there later, and Ctrl+Z takes each one back on its own.

**Move shows a handle in the view:** three arrows to move, three rings to rotate and a cube to scale evenly, labelled X, Y, Z and S. What moves is what is selected, the part or a hole in it; then the part stays put ([What Solidon recognises in a model](manual:features)). For every handle, the status line says what it will move.

**Typing instead of dragging.** Three buttons in the bar choose *Move*, *Rotate* or *Scale*, and the numbers stand beside them: X, Y, Z in millimetres, an angle in degrees, a factor in per cent or straight away the target size. Enter applies. During a drag the number is shown above the view; type a digit to take over the drag, Enter sets exactly that value without snapping, Esc discards the drag.

**The shadow follows.** Lift a part and it runs off to the side; without perspective, that is the only clue to the height.

**Moving with the handle never goes over the edge of the bed:** Solidon brings the body back to a free spot on the same plate. A typed value, on the other hand, applies as it stands; whether the part is still on the bed afterwards, the report says. If you let go of it over another bed, it ends up on that bed's plate.

**Grid snap and angle snap** sit behind the button with the grid and are set to zero out of the box, otherwise they would swallow every small drag. When rotating, the angle still clicks in briefly at multiples of 45 degrees, and an arc in the view shows it.

**With a face selected, the handle sits on it.** A drag offsets the face in its direction, and the neighbouring walls grow with it (*Offset face*): the 20 mm block becomes a 25 mm block. This works on imported models too and moves only the face you clicked. *Rotate* and *Scale* are then greyed out and say why in their tooltip.

**For exact sizes,** *Fit to size* sets a target dimension, and the dialog of *Scale* stretches per axis. *Align to feature* puts two parts together, face to face or hole to hole. Its target starts out empty, and *Apply* waits until you have chosen it. The first click in the view chooses it; the list in the *Target* field offers it too.

**Colour comes from the filament.** *Assign filament* takes the whole body, *Filament on a face* the face you clicked, including a rounded side such as the bowl of a letter. You choose a filament with a name and a colour, from your own inventory or newly created; at the very top is what the body already carries. In a 3MF export this becomes the filament change, and a part without its own filament keeps the colour of its body. *Remove filament* takes the assignment back for the selected bodies or faces.

**The filament inventory** opens from the start screen or via *Edit*. Every spool keeps its own remaining amount, even if two share a name; where the amount is not known, it says *Unknown*. The quick choice assigns a spool directly, on selected faces only to them. Changes in the inventory do not overwrite saved project colours or print values. A spool can carry up to four colours: the first is the one you see, and all of them reach Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and ElegooSlicer.
